changes.observation: Large dark chipped-looking islands are reduced; grip tonal field more continuous.
Coarse mottling reduced and outer bright rim retained, but dense fine wavy texture now more apparent.
Seven first-read copy entries match; type hierarchy, clear gaps, grayscale and visible hardware connections retained.

preserved_advantages: Large ordinary mounted lever and inserted key

residuals.location: Upper lever grip and protected neck; lower key head center
residuals.observation: Dark flaking-looking islands are reduced, but closely spaced wavy scratch/etch marks still cover almost every part of the grip and head, including protected areas. Both surfaces now have similar fine pattern scale.
residuals.impact: The broad smooth touched patch versus narrow smooth touched rim is still less distinct than specified.

residuals.location: Lower cylinder face and outer plate
residuals.observation: Dense scratch lines occupy much of the cylinder and plate, making protective and touched areas similarly weathered.
residuals.impact: Material finish competes with the contact-specific interpretation.

residuals.location: Central information area, detailed visit information
residuals.observation: The large title and both objects remain evident; small detail text is comfortable at usage720 and less comfortable at thumbnail size.
residuals.impact: All-detail readability is attested at usage720, not every possible display size.
